SELECTED_INDEX: 10
CONFIDENCE: 0.58
EXPLANATION: The intense 1677 cm⁻¹ band fits an amide-type C=O conjugated with an imine, while the weaker 1639 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with a C=N stretch; this dual feature is expected for CC=NC(C)=O but less so for simple enones/enenals (candidates 2, 9), which typically show a prominent C=C band near ~1620 and a strong trans out-of-plane =CH wag near ~970 cm⁻¹ (not observed here). The medium bands at 1453 and 1382 cm⁻¹ match aliphatic CH₂/CH₃ deformations (GFQ-003). The band at 837 cm⁻¹ is compatible with an imine =CH wag, and the spectrum lacks clear signatures of terminal/di-substituted alkene CH stretches or the strong ~970 cm⁻¹ trans vinyl wag expected for 2 or 9. Candidates with carbamates (1,4) would usually show stronger C–O–C/C–N features in the 1050–1250 cm⁻¹ region than observed.
